_comment: Agent Behavioral Intelligence golden scenarios (WO-002). Deterministic IDs. 'current' expectations are asserted against today's code; 'pending' expectations name the work order that must make them current. See docs/architecture/agent-behavior/01-golden-scenarios.md.

scenarios.title: Cross-device human to agent journey
scenarios.narrative: A person starts on mobile, continues on web through an explicit handoff, delegates a trip task to an orchestrator, which spawns two workers that call tools and return; the orchestrator returns the outcome.
known_gaps: Handoff and agent run are not joined by any canonical record; join_basis stays unknown until WO-060.
The human-to-orchestrator grant is a delegation record, not a graph edge: no HUMAN_DELEGATED_TO_AGENT edge is emitted when a grant is recorded (WO-021).
Agent refs are source-reported, not resolved identities (WO-011/WO-013).

scenarios.title: Risk / fleet scenario
scenarios.narrative: A Risk360-flagged actor's orchestrator spawns 15 workers that scan and quote swaps against one wallet over one shared RPC endpoint; one swap attempt is rejected. The fleet is attributed to the delegating person only as a reviewable hypothesis.
known_gaps: Cluster evidence must never collapse into a proven common operator; only a reviewer can confirm.
Economic attempt events are Silver facts only; Value/Risk do not yet consume them as behavior (WO-092/WO-093).

scenarios.title: Constrained non-action
scenarios.narrative: An agent with a purchase objective finds a candidate, a spend policy denies the purchase, and the agent abstains.
known_gaps: Non-selection caused by policy must not be read as a negative preference (ADR-AB-004).

scenarios.title: Failure adaptation
scenarios.narrative: Tool A fails, is retried and fails again; the agent switches to tool B, which succeeds.
known_gaps: No canonical retry or switch event exists; retry/switch must be derived from ordered tool facts (WO-030, WO-061).
Lineage counts failed calls as calls; success rate is not computed (WO-061).
